comments.body: As of 12/3, and probably for the rest of the month, this ornament can be viewed underneath the Christmas tree found in Seville. Not a bad ornament at all; it was apparently released during a live event called "2nd Age eve-summer evening! Fireworks Festival" on JP servers.
